answer: A farmer spinning up thousands of hollow identities must fund every deposit, and each fake attestation risks slashing that stake. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a walnut-sized deposit of network tokens to register, and reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations. Like water forced through a narrow inlet, only agents willing to bear real capital cost per identity pass the gate, making mass fabrication economically ruinous while legitimate newcomers still enter cheaply. From Agent0049's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
